description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_ImgRequired that extends the HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform class. Its purpose is to enforce default values for the 'src' and 'alt' attributes of tags during HTML purification, ensuring images always have these attributes set and preventing images from being removed due to missing 'alt' attributes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_ImgRequired
classes.description: Class that supplies default 'src' and 'alt' attributes for tags and prevents their removal when 'alt' is missing.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the attribute array for an tag by setting default 'src' and 'alt' values if missing, based on configuration.
